import copy, json, math
from work import evaluate

def check(req, pol, exp):
    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==exp,(got,exp); assert req==r0 and pol==p0; assert set(got)=={'ok','records','errors'}; assert all(set(x)=={'id','amount'} for x in got['records']); assert all(set(x)=={'row','cause'} for x in got['errors'])
p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}
check({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':3,'unit':'cm'}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':0.03}],'errors':[]})
check({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':[]},{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'a','amount':3}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':4,'cause':'duplicate'}]})
check({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'y','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'z','amount':-1}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})
check({'rows':[{'id':'q','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'q','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'unit'}]})
check({'rows':[{'id':'q','amount':1},{'id':'q','amount':2}]},{**p,'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'q','amount':1},{'id':'q','amount':2}],'errors':[]})
print('boundary checks passed')
